title: From green screen to transparent frames

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: You filmed something in front of a green screen. Now you want it on a transparent background. What's the path?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Right, and that's what Antoine's pipeline does with OpenCV. It reads the green-screen video, extracts the frames, and keys out the green.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: A sequence of PNG images with an alpha channel, so the background is truly transparent.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Because they're a flexible middle step. From those frames you can build a GIF, or feed a video codec that supports alpha. Capture, keying and final encoding stay separate.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The written page has the details.
